sources.name: Kanazawa Ministry of Justice registry-map parcels (2026, selected public-coordinate sheet 436)
sources.operator: 法務省 / Ministry of Justice; G-spatial Information Center distribution
sources.identityRecipe: JP-MOJ-2026-KANAZAWA-{published inner sheet filename without .zip}-{native 筆/@id}. Native municipality/package/sheet and edition namespaces; no geometry-derived identity.
sources.identityStabilityLimit: Pinned 2026 archive only; continuity across revised sheets or editions is unverified. Do not merge overlapping geometry identities.
sources.archiveHashBasis: Retained discovery full-archive hash; current runtime checks selected nested-sheet SHA-256, exact ranges, archive byte length and ETag. No whole-archive fetch.
sources.scope: Bounded Kanazawa coverage: only 2026 public-coordinate sheet 17201-2200-436, 45 native parcel records around 136.65006–136.65268 E, 36.62668–36.62893 N, about 6.8 km north of the unchanged city locator. No parcel coverage at the locator or citywide completeness is claimed. All other sheets, including central sheet 637 and arbitrary-coordinate sheets, are outside enabled scope.

projection.operation: Inverse Japan Plane Rectangular CS VII Transverse Mercator, latitude origin 36, longitude origin 137 10/60, scale 0.9999, GRS80. No fitted offset or additional datum grid applied.
projection.datumClassification: Root 測地系判別=変換; TKY2JGD 1.3.79, parameter 2.1.1. JGD2000/JGD2011 realization, epoch and original grid provenance remain second-pass uncertainties; EPSG:6675 is the documented initial implementation interpretation.

jurisdiction.basis: Live MOJ-authored CKAN identifies 金沢市 registry maps under Real Property Registration Act Article 14(1)/(4). Selected XML identifies municipality 17201 / 金沢市 and public coordinate zone VII.
